messages.text:
I found your cookware set order (h09-o1), but its status is "shipped", so it hasn't been delivered yet. Only delivered orders can be refunded through this process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). The shop's records also show no return received for it (refund-policy/v2/return).

Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside this process. Would you like a staff member to help with that?
